                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            comps.append((color, cells, r0, r1, c0, c1))

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells, r0, r1, c0, c1 in comps:
        # The objects are shifted vertically to the nearest edge: objects in
        # the top half go to row zero, those in the bottom half to the bottom.
        nr = 0 if r0 < h / 2 else h - (r1 - r0 + 1)
        for y, x in cells:
            out[nr + y - r0][x] = color
    return out
